title: View the contents of a text file in the terminal
summary: Display the entire content of a text file directly in your terminal window. This is useful for quickly checking configuration files or logs without opening a separate editor.

steps.explain: Run the `cat` command followed by the path to the file you want to view. The file's content will be printed to the screen.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the text file you want to view
